```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
using MatrixFreeOperators
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
export_names = filter(!=(:MatrixFreeOperators), names(MatrixFreeOperators))

classify(name, b) = startswith(string(name), "@") ? :macro :
    b isa Type ? :type : b isa Function ? :function : :constant

# `@` is a legal HTML id character but breaks the querySelector calls Quarto's nav makes.
anchor(name) = lowercase(replace(string(name), "@" => "macro-"))

if isempty(export_names)
    println("This package does not export any names yet.\n")
else
    println("""
    <div class="api-controls">
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" data-api-toggle="open">Open all</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" data-api-toggle="close">Close all</button>
    </div>
    """)
end

for (kind, label) in [(:type, "Types"), (:function, "Functions"), (:macro, "Macros"), (:constant, "Constants")]
    items = filter(n -> classify(n, getfield(MatrixFreeOperators, n)) == kind, export_names)
    isempty(items) && continue
    println("## $label\n")
    for name in items
        binding = getfield(MatrixFreeOperators, name)
        doc = string(Docs.doc(binding))
        println("""
        <details class="card mb-3 api-card">
        <summary class="card-header api-item-header"><h4 id="$(anchor(name))">`$name`</h4></summary>

        ::: {.card-body}
        $doc
        :::

        </details>
        """)
    end
end
```

<script>
(function() {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-api-toggle]").forEach(function(btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function() {
            var open = btn.dataset.apiToggle === "open";
            document.querySelectorAll("details.api-card").forEach(function(d) { d.open = open; });
        });
    });

    // Browsers do not expand a closed <details> when navigating to an id inside it,
    // so a deep link or search hit would otherwise land on a collapsed card.
    function revealTarget() {
        var id = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1));
        var el = id && document.getElementById(id);
        var card = el && el.closest("details.api-card");
        // Expanding only adds content below the summary, so the browser's own
        // scroll to the anchor stays correct.
        if (card) card.open = true;
    }
    revealTarget();
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", revealTarget);
})();
</script>
